raw_ocr_text:
DEED

This Deed is made on June 18 , 2003

BETWEEN  Gerald K. Keller and Sharon B. Keller, husband and wife, having an
address of P.O. Box 2650, Cherry Hill, NJ 08034, referred to as the Grantors,

AND  Gerald K. Keller and Sharon B. Keller as tenants in common, having
an address of P.O. Box 2650, Cherry Hill, NJ 08034, referred to as the Grantees.

1.  Transfer of Ownership.  The Grantors grant and convey (transfer ownership of)
the property described below to the Grantees.  This transfer is made for the sum of
One Dollar ($1.00).  The Grantors acknowledge receipt of this money.

2.  Tax Map Reference.  (N.J.S.A. 46:15-2.1)  Block 426.01, Lot 17  of the Official
Tax Map.

3.  Property.  The property consists of the land and premises located in the Township
of Cherry Hill, County of Camden and State of New Jersey.  The legal description is:

SEE SCHEDULE A ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF.

Being the same land and premises which became vested in Grantors by Deed
from Centrum Prop...
